assertion.text: Erdős Problem #410: declared status 'open'. Formalized: yes. Let $\sigma_1(n)=\sigma(n)$, the sum of divisors function, and $\sigma_k(n)=\sigma(\sigma_{k-1}(n))$. Is it true that\[\lim_{k\to \infty} \sigma_k(n)^{1/k}=\infty?\] Prize: no. OEIS: A007497. Tags: iterated functions, number theory.
